svg.title: Deployment Stamps
svg.desc: Deployment Stamps. Deploy many independent copies of the whole stack, each serving a subset of tenants. Step 1, One deployment hits limits: One US deployment: no bigger tier to grow into, a big tenant slows all, and EU data has no home. Step 2, Many copies, one template: One template, deployed as stamps 1 to 3. The router looks up each tenant's stamp in the catalog. Step 3, Placing tenants: A new EU tenant goes to stamp 3. The US stamps are full, so automation adds stamp 4 for new ones. Step 4, Operating many stamps: v8 rolls out ring by ring, Fabrikam moves to stamp 4, and the global parts stay highly available.

g.text: One US deployment: no bigger tier to grow into, a big tenant slows all, and EU data has no home.
One template, deployed as stamps 1 to 3. The router looks up each tenant's stamp in the catalog.
A new EU tenant goes to stamp 3. The US stamps are full, so automation adds stamp 4 for new ones.
v8 rolls out ring by ring, Fabrikam moves to stamp 4, and the global parts stay highly available.
